seo.meta_title: Auntie Anne's Pretzel Nuggets: How Many, Calories & Price
seo.meta_description: How many Auntie Anne's pretzel nuggets come in a small or regular cup, calories for each flavor, prices, and how they compare with Mini Pretzel Dogs.

question: How Many Pretzel Nuggets Come in an Auntie Anne's Cup?
quick_answer: Auntie Anne's Pretzel Nuggets are bite-size pieces of its pretzel dough, sold in Original, Cinnamon Sugar and Pepperoni. A small cup has about 19 Original or Cinnamon Sugar nuggets and a regular has about 26, according to Auntie Anne's nutrition guide. A regular Original order is about 580 calories, and a regular Cinnamon Sugar is about 680. Prices run about $6.43 for a small and $7.35 for a regular at many stores.
key_facts: Small cup: about 19 nuggets; regular: about 26

body.heading: What Auntie Anne's Pretzel Nuggets are
body.text: Pretzel Nuggets, which many people call pretzel bites, are small pieces of the same dough Auntie Anne's uses for its full-size pretzels. They're baked fresh, brushed with butter and topped like the full pretzels, then served in a cup for sharing and dipping. The main flavors are Original (salted), Cinnamon Sugar and Pepperoni, and Auntie Anne's sometimes adds limited-time flavors.

body.heading: How many nuggets you get
body.text: Auntie Anne's nutrition guide lists about 19 nuggets in a small cup and about 26 in a regular for Original and Cinnamon Sugar. Pepperoni nuggets are bigger, so you get about 14 in a small and 19 in a regular. Auntie Anne's has said its brand standard is a 16 oz small cup and a 21 oz regular cup. Because the nuggets are counted by hand, your exact count may be a few more or less.

body.heading: Calories and nutrition
body.text: According to Auntie Anne's, a small Original Nuggets order has about 430 calories and a regular has about 580, with about 1,450 mg of sodium in the regular. Cinnamon Sugar Nuggets are sweeter and higher in calories: about 500 for a small and 680 for a regular. Pepperoni Nuggets run about 480 calories for a small and 650 for a regular. Dips add more calories; you can also ask for nuggets without butter to cut some calories.

body.heading: Nuggets vs. Mini Pretzel Dogs
body.text: Mini Pretzel Dogs are a different item: mini Nathan's Famous hot dogs wrapped in pretzel dough. A small has about 10 pieces and 700 calories, and a regular has about 14 pieces and 980 calories, according to Auntie Anne's. They're more filling than nuggets but much higher in calories and sodium.

body.heading: Prices and buckets
body.text: At many stores, a small cup of Pretzel Nuggets costs about $6.43 and a regular about $7.35, with higher prices at airports and some malls. For groups, Auntie Anne's sells Pretzel Nugget Buckets with about 90 to 100 pieces, or five servings, plus party trays with 180 to 200 nuggets. See our Auntie Anne's menu page for more prices.

faqs.q: How many pretzel nuggets are in a small at Auntie Anne's?
faqs.a: About 19 Original or Cinnamon Sugar nuggets, according to Auntie Anne's nutrition guide.

faqs.q: How many pretzel nuggets are in a regular at Auntie Anne's?
faqs.a: About 26 Original or Cinnamon Sugar nuggets.

faqs.q: How many calories are in Auntie Anne's pretzel nuggets?
faqs.a: About 430 for a small Original order and 580 for a regular. Cinnamon Sugar is about 500 and 680.

faqs.q: Are pretzel nuggets and pretzel bites the same?
faqs.a: Yes. Auntie Anne's calls them Pretzel Nuggets; many people call them pretzel bites.

faqs.q: How many nuggets are in an Auntie Anne's bucket?
faqs.a: About 90 to 100 pretzel nuggets, or five servings.
